description: Riolering - leidingen en putten Arnhem is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Gemeente Arnhem. Op deze kaart vindt u informatie over de rioolstelsels bestaande uit (pers)leidingen en putten in en om de stad Arnhem. Voor het merendeel van de riolering die wordt getoond is de gemeente Arnhem eigenaar en beheerder. Echter zijn hier uitzonderingen op, waarbij de riolering in beheer en eigendom is van derden. Coverage: Gemeente Arnhem. The portal files it under the publisher Gemeente Arnhem. Its tags are Leidingen, Putten, Riolering, Strengen, Water. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, KML, Shapefile, WFS. The portal shows 2026-09-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
